title: A CACHE NAME IS DRAWN OVER THE WALLS
why: His note with a picture: the CHILL ROW CACHE name was cut in two by a wall, and the text should be on top. The name was drawn with its box in the depth-sorted world pass, so a wall in front of the box covered it. It is now drawn in the world text pass beside the nameplates, after every wall.
now: A named cache shows its name over the walls instead of behind them.
